# Stimpunks.Love

> Queer without fear. Interdependent and here. Divergent and proud. Living out loud. Plucky pluralism, for human organisms. Becoming and belonging, with ribald songing.

A Stimpunks Foundation site, and the loud one. It has no single design system on purpose: the street is the system and the six rooms refuse to share one. Two habits survive from our careful sites — attribution, which is a licence rather than a house style, and contrast, because clashing is not the same as illegible.

Every page carries an intensity dial with three settings. It defaults to whatever the visitor's device asks for and lets them turn it up past that; Gentle removes motion and sparkle and never removes content.

## The rooms

- [Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/): Queer without fear. Interdependent and here. Divergent and proud. Living out loud. One street, six rooms, and a dial that lets you decide how loud it gets. A Stimpunks Foundation site.
- [Pink Pony Club — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/pink-pony-club.html): The dancefloor. Ten songs our own pages already credit, in one jukebox. Nothing plays until you press play — no autoplay, and nothing reaches YouTube before you ask for it.
- [The Zine Table — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/zine-table.html): Xerox, staples, ransom note. The room where we get angry in ten point type — and the room that explains which two things stay careful even here.
- [The Zine Table, Issue #2: One Root, Two Rainbows — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/zine-issue-2.html): Seven lessons on neurodiversity and gender, photocopied down to one sheet. Distilled from our own library, with the course linked and the song left unprinted.
- [Hear Queer Here — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/hear-queer-here.html): Quantum queering: reading queerness and the physics of indeterminacy through each other. Nothing is fixed, bounded, or settled in advance of its relations.
- [Enid's Room — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/enids-room.html): Colorful goth. Black walls, technicolour everything else, and somewhere to sit when the glee runs out. The room for the one who doesn't match the house.
- [The Playhouse — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/playhouse.html): Everything is a button and every button yells. The glossary wearing a costume — and every toy is a real control that Tab reaches and a screen reader names.
- [Your Room — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/your-room.html): An empty storefront on the street, with the keys in the door. One person from the community gets a page here, their own stylesheet, and their name on it.
- [Liner Notes — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/liner-notes.html): Who made this noise. Every song, typeface, quotation and borrowed name on this street, credited to the person it belongs to.
- [Changelog — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/changelog.html): What changed on the street, and when. Every Stimpunks site publishes one of these.
